name: amber-protocol
description: Amber Protocol: repository-local governance kit for coding agents — init, audit, wiki, doctor, and handoff workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Install and validate a safe repository-local Amber Protocol setup.
interface.longDescription: Amber Protocol provides V1-safe init, audit, wiki, doctor, and handoff workflows for agent-friendly repositories. It does not run dynamic workflows or dispatch subagents.
interface.defaultPrompt: Initialize or audit a repository-local Amber Protocol setup.
